definition: A constraint that carries a machine test beside its sentence, so a house can be checked against it wherever the figures the test reads are known. The test formalises only what the sentence states; the rest stays in words.
basis: schema/constraint.schema.json: a test is "Present only when scope is not 'judgment' and the statement itself supplies a number or an enumerable set", and "if the test can only formalise part of the statement, the test covers that part and the rest stays prose". VISION.md: "The sentence is what a person argues with; the test is what a machine enforces".
